Frequency Origins

Is there a physical explanation for why the brain's frequency bands are what they are?

Physical time constants, network delays, interneuron-driven E–I loops, and body–environment rhythms act as constraints. Their intersection yields stable, band-limited eigenmodes — the canonical delta–gamma spectrum.
